description: Nimir Industrial Chemicals Limited was incorporated on 6 February 1994 as Ravi Alkalis Limited and listed on the Pakistan Stock Exchange in 1996. It took its present name in March 1998 after the business passed to a Saudi group, and since a management buyout in 2011 has been run by its senior management. The company describes itself as a pioneer of new chemical technologies in Pakistan, introducing oleo-chemicals (2000), soap noodles (2007), commercial-scale soap finishing (2014), aerosols (2020) and chlorinated paraffin wax (2022). Its portfolio spans oleo chemicals, chlor alkali, aerosols and personal and home care products, and it also provides third-party manufacturing.
sourceNote: Company website (nimir.com.pk/nicl: who-we-are, company-information), read 2026-10-17. Address and phone are the Lahore office the company publishes; the plant is at 14.8 km on the Sheikhupura–Faisalabad Road, Bhikhi.
